provenance.massGeometrySteering: Reverified 2026-09-25 against manufacturer 2021 Pacifica Hybrid specifications pp. 2-5, retrieved from the manufacturer media asset host. Values describe the stock vehicle at curb weight, not occupied/instrumented MnCAV.
provenance.lfLr: Derived from stock wheelbase and static front/rear load fractions: lf=L*rearFraction, lr=L*frontFraction.
provenance.yawInertia: Joint yaw/lateral-velocity identification with public stock mass and axle-load-derived CG fixed; conditional model, not directly measured inertia.
provenance.corneringStiffness: Complete-axle stiffnesses from the public-constrained multi-recording fit, adopted 2026-09-25. Conditional on stock mass/CG, calibrated output point and linear bicycle assumptions.
provenance.actualLoadedMass: Unknown: no payload, occupancy or sensor-rack mass is invented.
provenance.sensorNoiseDelay: See mncavSensorParameters.json and mncavSensorConfig: recorded DBW observer IMU is distinct from the NovAtel G320N reference IMU; noise priors, OEM random walks, native rates and calibrated equivalents are separate.

assumptions.selectionPolicy: Use the public-constrained nominal identification adopted by user instruction on 2026-09-25. Geometry, stock mass and CG are fixed; stiffness and inertia are fitted constants. Re-synthesize observer gains for this vehicle configuration.
assumptions.nominalMassPolicy: Use published curb mass 2273 kg as the nominal anchor. No occupants or sensor-rack mass is asserted. Actual loaded mass is unknown.
assumptions.axleCorneringStiffnessUnits: N/rad for the complete axle, not each tire; do not multiply by two again.
assumptions.massSensitivityMeaning: Illustrative loaded-mass scenarios up to the published stock GVWR; no recorded payload or operational bound is inferred.
assumptions.cgSensitivityMeaning: Assumed longitudinal CG shifts about the stock axle-load-derived location; keep wheelbase fixed; not a confidence interval.

identification.parameterScope: Conditional nominal model; actual loaded mass/CG remain unknown.
identification.gainPolicy: Previously saved gains/certificates belong to their stored vehicle model; synthesize and validate new gains before claiming a certificate for this configuration.
